messages.text: Стиль «Максимум мест»: по пути добавлено мест — 20, чтобы занять окно 09:00–21:00. Только выбранные слоты — выключите «Добавлять места по пути».
Пешие отрезки посчитаны по прямой (оценка): 29 из 29 — по улицам путь может быть длиннее.

Пешие отрезки посчитаны по прямой (оценка): 30 из 30 — по улицам путь может быть длиннее.
Стиль «Максимум мест»: по пути добавлено мест — 18, чтобы занять окно 09:00–21:00. Только выбранные слоты — выключите «Добавлять места по пути».
Пешие отрезки посчитаны по прямой (оценка): 27 из 27 — по улицам путь может быть длиннее.

11484690504626613379.name: Boteanu Church
11484690504626613379.summary: A small, historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, known for its layered history, painted interior, icons, and intimate services.

284364362787826053.name: Dulcinella Bălcescu
284364362787826053.summary: A cozy pastry cafe for fresh cakes, New York rolls, balanced sweets, coffee, and a quick morning treat.

7474627049727210020.name: "Ion Luca Caragiale" National Theatre
7474627049727210020.summary: Major central theater complex with striking modern architecture, multiple halls, rooftop performances, and backstage tours.

15978145016794525298.name: University Square
15978145016794525298.summary: Historic central Bucharest square framed by the university and grand civic buildings, with statues, events, cafes, and a lively route into the Old Town.

1488282260368912949.name: Antic ExLibris
1488282260368912949.type_label: Discount bookstore specializing in English-language titles
1488282260368912949.summary: A multi-room Old Town treasure hunt for budget-minded readers, gift hunters and anyone drawn to unexpected finds.

6194615972455793446.name: The New "Saint George" Church
6194615972455793446.summary: Historic Orthodox church with lavish frescoes, mosaics, carved columns and the ornate tomb of Constantin Brancoveanu in central Bucharest.

15030974955433322990.name: Romanian Boutique
15030974955433322990.summary: Two-room Old Town souvenir shop combining Romanian-made ceramics, embroidered blouses, handmade crafts and affordable everyday gifts with unusually knowledgeable multilingual service.

4799452667097853425.name: St. Anthony’s Church
4799452667097853425.summary: A small, atmospheric Orthodox church in Bucharest's Old Town, known for sixteenth-century heritage, frescoes, icons, Brancovenesc details, and a peaceful courtyard.

7192375974987078804.name: Museum of Communism in Bucharest
7192375974987078804.summary: A compact, hands-on museum of Romanian communism, with authentic household objects, room replicas, historical panels, vintage clothes and helpful guides.

10915586233752676659.name: The Church of the "Stavropoleos" Monastery
10915586233752676659.summary: A tiny eighteenth-century Orthodox monastery church with ornate Brancovenesc carvings, vivid frescoes, a peaceful cloister and a serene courtyard in Bucharest Old Town.

15791376739079194771.name: Zlatari Church
15791376739079194771.summary: Historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, known for ornate frescoes, rare stained glass, a peaceful interior, and revered Saint Cyprian relics.

10689884438600396423.name: UNU
10689884438600396423.summary: A sprawling old-world treasure hunt for collectors, gift seekers and readers who enjoy browsing shelves, cabinets and unexpected finds.

10146158162049940249.name: St. Nicholas in-a-Day Church
10146158162049940249.summary: A small historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, with a modest exterior, richly painted interior, icons, and a peaceful courtyard atmosphere.

6438193657888648583.name: Stadio Atrium
6438193657888648583.summary: Stylish atrium restaurant with garden-like decor, cocktails, Romanian-leaning small plates, and a polished brunch-to-dinner flow in central Bucharest.

18276145252857782250.name: The "Excelsior" Theatre
18276145252857782250.summary: Modern small-scale theatre with strong acting, musicals, and youth-focused programming in a clean, intimate setting.

10825115157458193067.name: Artichoke
10825115157458193067.type_label: specialty coffee shop and cocktail bar
10825115157458193067.summary: Cozy central Bucharest cafe-bar with specialty coffee by day, creative drinks by night, and a terrace facing historic church and museum views.

10934602441818715559.name: Kretzulescu Park
10934602441818715559.summary: Small, central urban park beside Kretzulescu Church, offering a quiet bench break, grassy patches and an easy pause between Bucharest sights.

9762822817967543429.name: Velonova Mirage 3D Museum
9762822817967543429.summary: An immersive Bucharest museum of optical illusions, interactive 3D scenes and recycled-metal sculpture rooms, built for playful photos with friends or family.

17892048697579349778.name: Teatrul Elisabeta
17892048697579349778.summary: Elegant central theater known for comedies, dinner shows, and candlelight concerts in a small historic building.

17163369997001630049.name: Piața Valter Mărăcineanu
17163369997001630049.summary: A public town square suited to a brief outdoor stop, with space to pause, orient yourself, and take in the surrounding city.

7990683008413957887.name: Mystery Rooms Escape
7990683008413957887.summary: Large, puzzle-heavy escape room center with multiple themed adventures, friendly game masters, and strong options for groups, families, and experienced players.

4658405126684418777.name: Saint Joseph’s Catholic Cathedral
4658405126684418777.summary: Ornate nineteenth-century Catholic cathedral with Gothic and Romanesque details, stained glass, frescoes, a marble altar, organ music, and a peaceful interior.
4658405126684418777.address: Palatul Arhiepiscopal, Strada General H. M. Berthelot 19, București

3194071635121029397.name: The Palace Hall
3194071635121029397.summary: Large central concert hall with strong acoustics, big shows, and historic character, though the seats are old and tight.

16044012576954065712.name: National Museum of Art
16044012576954065712.type_label: national art museum in a former royal palace
16044012576954065712.summary: A grand former royal palace housing Romanian, European, Islamic and East Asian art, with medieval icons, modern masters, sculpture and ornate historic rooms.

16191850212067792483.name: Red Goblin
16191850212067792483.summary: Large, well-organized geek shop with board games, comics, manga, figurines, Funko Pops, trading cards, apparel and basement gaming spaces.

6517745912057984754.name: The Romanian Athenaeum
6517745912057984754.type_label: historic concert hall and cultural landmark
6517745912057984754.summary: Iconic neoclassical concert hall and landmark with a grand frescoed auditorium, strong acoustics, and ticketed tours or concerts.

14472836660343011448.name: Cărturești Verona
14472836660343011448.summary: A maze-like Bucharest bookshop in a historic villa, pairing extensive reading stock with gifts, music and quiet corners for lingering.
14472836660343011448.address: Strada Pictor Arthur Verona 13-15, 030167 București, Romania

9915577282125126834.name: The Void Escape Room Bucuresti
9915577282125126834.summary: Immersive escape room venue with cinematic themes, automated puzzles, and challenging rooms best for friends, couples, and team outings.

2302333767644454498.name: Equestrian Statue of Carol I
2302333767644454498.summary: A monumental bronze equestrian statue of Romania's first king, set among Bucharest's grand historic buildings and ideal for a quick photo stop.

3325034453752002666.name: French Revolution Ateneul Român
3325034453752002666.type_label: gourmet eclair and specialty coffee shop
3325034453752002666.summary: A tiny takeaway counter known for refined, creative eclairs and good coffee, ideal after visiting the Romanian Athenaeum; currently closed.

14636091576834155908.name: Cafe Chocolat Ateneu
14636091576834155908.summary: Elegant cafe-confectionery for pastries, desserts, coffee, and brunch, with a polished terrace, styled presentation, and a refined city-center feel.

12884893661919218190.name: Rio Juice
12884893661919218190.summary: Brazilian-style juice and açaí bar serving fresh bowls, smoothies, and coffee in a cozy, colorful space with a quiet back-room feel.
12884893661919218190.address: Calea Victoriei. 100 cu, intrare din, Strada Nicolae Crețulescu, 030167 București

84644100838256775.name: Piața Revoluției
84644100838256775.summary: Historic Bucharest square centered on a Revolution memorial, with an obelisk, statues and landmark buildings including the Royal Palace and Athenaeum.

1674269970540788428.name: Piaţa Alexandru Lahovari
1674269970540788428.summary: Piata Alexandru Lahovari is an open urban square for a brief pause, a walk through, and a simple city photograph.

10864595662914695815.name: Nottara Theatre
10864595662914695815.summary: Historic Bucharest theatre with intimate seating, strong acting, and a varied playbill in a central, elegant setting.
10864595662914695815.address: Bulevardul General Gheorghe Magheru 20, 010334 București, Romania

7918186604865741958.name: my romanian store
7918186604865741958.summary: A calm, story-rich Bucharest boutique for authentic Romanian crafts, thoughtful gifts and beautifully made keepsakes by local artists.

2323796184066607182.name: National Museum of Romanian Literature
2323796184066607182.summary: A richly presented museum of Romanian literary culture, with manuscripts, writers' belongings, artworks, interactive displays and audio guides in a restored historic house.

15387643079662744112.name: White Church Bucharest
15387643079662744112.summary: A small, elegant Orthodox church with a whitewashed facade, Brancovenesc details, Tattarescu paintings, peaceful worship, and a celebrated choir.

7134420911640911719.name: The Royal Palace of Bucharest
7134420911640911719.type_label: Art museum in a former royal palace
7134420911640911719.summary: Bucharest's ornate former royal residence now houses Romania's national art museum, with grand interiors, royal rooms, and major Romanian collections.

6975675940809821901.name: Kretzulescu Church
6975675940809821901.summary: Compact red-brick Orthodox church from the 1720s, rich with Brancovenesc detail, frescoes and a quiet spiritual atmosphere beside Bucharest's Revolution Square.

3385408437322307444.name: Constantin Tanase Theater
3385408437322307444.summary: Historic revue theater with satirical comedy, music, dance, and glittering costumes in a renovated, compact venue.

7258057226082793606.name: Cărturești Modul
7258057226082793606.type_label: architecture and design bookstore with cafe
7258057226082793606.summary: Architecture-focused bookstore with art and design titles, Romanian gifts, a garden cafe, exhibitions and a cosy place to read or work.

8825391489902434532.name: The Italian Church
8825391489902434532.summary: A small red-brick Italian Catholic church in central Bucharest, blending neo-Romanesque and neo-Gothic design with vivid murals and a peaceful interior.

513869177365022503.name: 60 Minutes Escape Room Bucharest
513869177365022503.summary: Immersive escape room center with themed, high-energy puzzles, strong teamwork focus, and several tight, detail-packed rooms.

17991847120941406752.name: Darvari Skete
17991847120941406752.summary: A serene Orthodox skete in central Bucharest, with a simple white church, interior frescoes, a leafy garden, and a rare sense of retreat from city noise.

4658762096759121924.name: Icon's Church
4658762096759121924.summary: A serene Orthodox church in central Bucharest, known for its intimate historic interior, vivid frescoes, revered Marian icon and flower-filled garden.

11869969834450145288.name: Librăria Humanitas
11869969834450145288.summary: A quiet bookstore pairs literary browsing with an unusually broad Japanese-culture gift corner, from housewares to clothing.

9185679158235506995.name: Artmark
9185679158235506995.type_label: historic art auction house and gallery
9185679158235506995.summary: Browse rotating art, jewelry, furniture and collectibles inside a beautifully restored historic palace that also hosts auctions and cultural events.

3676382838556882236.name: "Theodor Aman" Museum
3676382838556882236.type_label: historic house museum and art museum
3676382838556882236.summary: A compact 19th-century artist's home and studio filled with Theodor Aman's paintings, engravings, carved furniture, stained glass, and preserved interiors.
3676382838556882236.address: Strada C. A. Rosetti 8, 010283 București, Romania

3861669762656772750.name: Hathor Magic Books&More
3861669762656772750.summary: Multi-floor spiritual emporium with a vintage atmosphere, an extensive crystal floor, tarot and oracle decks, ritual supplies, incense, and unusual gifts.

8515649397652243988.name: Club 99
8515649397652243988.summary: Packed comedy club for stand-up nights, with close-up stage views, drinks at the table, and a lively, cramped room.

16017327893250240033.name: Teatrul Metropolis
16017327893250240033.summary: Intimate Bucharest theater with comfortable seats, a stylish interior, and a strong lineup of plays, musicals, and dramatic performances.

2812718207382082871.name: Captive Escape Room
2812718207382082871.summary: A large escape-room venue with original themed rooms, creative puzzles, and a friendly briefing area that suits groups and repeat visits.

17984105070454722416.name: Cinema "Elvire Popesco"
17984105070454722416.summary: Cozy independent cinema with a curated mix of European, indie, and festival films, plus a calm, elegant setting and comfortable seats.

17490089852047944108.name: "Țăndărică" Theater
17490089852047944108.summary: Historic puppet theater with lively, child-friendly shows, modernized spaces, and clear appeal for families and adults alike.

10823204890905176614.name: Grădina cu Filme
10823204890905176614.summary: An intimate open-air cinema and event terrace in the city center, with summer film screenings, concerts, drinks, and a cozy garden feel.

4243283208342501467.name: Yeshua Tova Synagogue
4243283208342501467.summary: Active Chabad synagogue in central Bucharest, offering Jewish prayer, Shabbat gatherings, a warm community atmosphere, and kosher food.

13484124012727544921.name: George Enescu Square
13484124012727544921.summary: A central Bucharest square beside the Athenaeum, royal palace and museums, known for historic surroundings, open-air concerts and cultural festivals.

5564669006134392295.name: Velocità
5564669006134392295.summary: A destination gelateria known for creamy Italian-style gelato, standout salted pistachio and affogato, with vegan flavors and queues at busy times.

11525635674185778928.name: Cookie Beacon Brunch
11525635674185778928.summary: Stylish, high-energy brunch spot known for oversized cookies, generous portions, and a busy walk-in-only setup in central Bucharest.

10039533104628781535.name: Kyut_Social
10039533104628781535.summary: Cozy coffee-and-cocktail spot with Italian-style espresso, good cocktails, and a small plant-filled interior plus outdoor seating.

5011513780398087395.name: Breakout Bucharest
5011513780398087395.summary: Themed escape-room venue with four interactive, story-driven rooms, strong set design, and a friendly, organized game-master style.
5011513780398087395.address: Strada General Nicolae C. Dona 18, 010782 București

6243762450561891153.name: "Cazzavillan" Park
6243762450561891153.summary: A small Italianate pocket park centered on a historic statue fountain, with columnar trees, quiet benches, a playground, and strong architectural-photo appeal.

15635477874173947398.name: Sala Radio
15635477874173947398.summary: Historic concert hall with outstanding acoustics, comfortable seating, and a strong classical and jazz program in a mid-century setting.
15635477874173947398.address: Strada General H. M. Berthelot 60-64, București

5552334153958304609.name: Bucharest National Opera House
5552334153958304609.summary: Romania’s main opera house pairs grand historic architecture with opera, ballet, and classical productions in an elegant central hall.

8805292627153432854.name: The National Military Museum
8805292627153432854.summary: A sprawling Romanian military-history museum tracing warfare from prehistoric weapons and Roman-era maps to modern vehicles, uniforms, aircraft and artillery.

3625590850488130408.name: Matache Market
3625590850488130408.summary: Matache Market is a modest Bucharest neighborhood market for fresh produce, local meat and dairy, honey, spices, and a quick mici-and-beer stop.

8761465268741513440.name: Teatrul Dramaturgilor Români
8761465268741513440.summary: Intimate Romanian drama theater with a varied repertory, close-up seating, and English surtitles for many performances.

1300292552306378781.name: Grigore Antipa National Museum of Natural History
1300292552306378781.summary: Explore Bucharest's standout natural history museum, filled with lifelike wildlife dioramas, dinosaur skeletons, fossils, minerals, insects and a humpback whale skeleton.

17832584452697407502.name: Nautilus English Books
17832584452697407502.summary: A tiny, book-packed English-language shop with comics, hard-to-find titles and helpful staff.

4761944489402296337.name: Zambaccian Art Museum
4761944489402296337.summary: An intimate villa museum pairing major Romanian art with French masters including Renoir, Matisse, Cezanne and Picasso, plus courtyard sculptures.

15657174015701929480.name: National museum of maps and ancient books
15657174015701929480.summary: A charming small museum in a 1920s villa, filled with historic maps, painted ceilings, stained glass, puzzles, and cartographic discoveries.

17222249692972698749.name: Kultho
17222249692972698749.summary: Luxury gold and diamond jewelry meets curated Swiss watches in an elegant, consultative boutique with strong product expertise.

14159880698056564170.name: The Escape Room
14159880698056564170.summary: Immersive escape room venue with automated puzzles, themed rooms, and family-friendly play for groups, kids, and first-timers.

6813728145016850858.name: "Vasile Urseanu" Astronomical Observatory
6813728145016850858.type_label: public astronomical observatory and space exhibit
6813728145016850858.summary: Historic public observatory with a small hands-on space exhibit and rooftop telescope sessions for moon and planet viewing.

13586446863539050445.name: "Nicolae Iorga" Park
13586446863539050445.summary: A compact, leafy oasis on central Calea Victoriei, with shaded benches, playgrounds, basketball, fitness and table tennis around a Nichita Stanescu statue.
13586446863539050445.address: Parcul Nicolae Iorga, Intrarea Nicolae Iorga 4, București, Romania

15678431129493490891.name: Museum of Art Collections
15678431129493490891.type_label: Art museum in a historic palace
15678431129493490891.summary: A vast palace museum of donated collections, rich in Romanian painting, decorative arts, icons and international works; allow several hours to explore.

10610160440173177730.name: Libraria franceza Kyralina
10610160440173177730.summary: Independent French-language bookstore with a cozy children's corner, strong comics selection, curated titles for all ages, and knowledgeable staff.

17157986075845435184.name: London Club
17157986075845435184.summary: Elegant pool and snooker club in a historic building, with quiet rooms, drinks, and a distinctive old-world interior.

9825589288657203031.name: Teatrul „Ion Creangă” - Sala Mare
9825589288657203031.summary: Renovated children’s theater with lively folktale shows, colorful staging, and a warm family focus in a compact central hall.

15162603895381257761.name: EscapeReality - Escape Rooms București
15162603895381257761.summary: High-tech escape room venue with richly detailed themed rooms, augmented-reality puzzles, and immersive story-driven play for groups.

13856892639579919952.name: Târgul Cărții
13856892639579919952.summary: Small, shelf-packed antiquarian bookstore with used and new titles, vintage multilingual books, vinyl, CDs and cassettes near central Bucharest.

14147436869860924214.name: "Ion Mincu" Memorial House
14147436869860924214.summary: A carefully restored former home of architect Ion Mincu, now an intimate heritage venue for architecture exhibitions, concerts, conferences, and cultural events.
14147436869860924214.address: Strada Pictor Arthur Verona 19, 030167 București, Romania
